title: Primer of the Kama and Kusari
summary: Teaches the stance, grip and first plain cuts, throws and retrievals of the kama and chain to an unawakened beginner.

title: Handbook of the Swinging Loop
summary: Drills the wrist loop and the first overarm and sidelong weight strikes for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Reaper's Short Drill-Book
summary: Sets out low crouching cuts at the ankle and shin, with the haft and chain as guards, for body-only students.

title: A Beginner's Treatise on Chain Casting
summary: Teaches the open-palm cast, the hip-turn fling and the feel of the swinging weight to students with toughened tendons.

title: Workbook of the Crescent Blade Grip
summary: Gives bone-stage students exercises in the reverse grip, inner-edge rakes, pommel knocks and the hooking of collars and elbows.

title: Primer of Qi Along the Kama Haft
summary: Shows a student who circulates qi how to carry it along the haft and chain in plain thrusts and throws.

title: Handbook of the Hooked Guard
summary: Teaches the cross guard of hook and haft, the catching of falling blades and the counter hook to the wrist.

title: Drill-Book of the Weighted Cast
summary: Drills measured casts at a fixed mark, the return haul and the covering loop for new qi users.

title: A Treatise on Slack and Tension
summary: Explains how to hold slack in the chain, snap it taut and read the line's pull in a fight.

title: Canon of the Reaping Arc
summary: Sets out the wide reaping arc, its return cut, high and low sweeps and the stopping guard, for qi-circulating students.
